title: Polynomial translation modules with normalized monomial coprojections
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra field $F$ with the extended norm, and $r,m\geq0$. Let $A_F$ be the bundled all-continuous condensed ring [def-sfb-bundled-continuous-scalar-ring] in the compatible universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Put $L=\mathbf Z_\ell^r$, with its inverse-limit topology, and let $I=(\{1,\ldots,r\}\sqcup\{1,\ldots,m\})\to_0\mathbf N$ be the monomial exponents of [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. A polynomial translation model is an internal $A_F$-module with internal $L$-action [def-sfb-condensed-action-module], together with coprojections $\iota_d:A_F\to T$ that exhibit $T$ as the coproduct of regular modules indexed by $d\in I$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. For every profinite $S$, every $g\in C(S,L)$, exponent $d$, and coefficient $c\in C(S,F)$, require $g\cdot\iota_d(c)=\sum_e\iota_e(\operatorname{coeff}_e((y-g)^az^b)c)$, where $d=(a,b)$ and the coefficient polynomial is obtained by actual multivariate substitution over $C(S,F)$. Thus translations affect all $y$ variables and fix all spectators $z$; the formula holds for varying continuous parameters and determines the action on every profinite test object. This is a specification of a monomial coproduct and its action, with no degree bound or completion.
